episodes.synopsis: Mona Kawai had never met a boy who could resist her charms. Enter Medaka Kuroiwa, who not only withstands her every move but also acts like he's disgusted by them! Is Mona's queen bee ego capable of taking no for an answer?
episodes.title: Can't Charm Him

episodes.synopsis: Mona continues her attempts to charm Medaka, but she suddenly realizes that she might have competition?
episodes.title: In Love with Him

episodes.synopsis: It’s time for the school festival, and Mona is convinced that the event vibes will make her moves on Medaka more effective. Is she right, though?
episodes.title: School Festival with Him

episodes.synopsis: Mona and Medaka find themselves at the Bridge of Love, the location of the school festival legend.
episodes.title: Legend with Him

episodes.synopsis: Mona and Medaka encounter Asahi Shonan, a strong-willed basketball star who seems rather confrontational.
episodes.title: Basketball Girl with Him

episodes.synopsis: When Medaka comes down with a cold, caring for him becomes a new battleground for Mona and Asahi.
episodes.title: Nursing with Him

episodes.synopsis: A new battle arises over the fate of Medaka's phone wallpaper... and Halloween costumes for the girls.
episodes.title: Lockscreen with Him

episodes.synopsis: Mona sets out for the Halloween party, her sights set on making Medaka's lockscreen.
episodes.title: Halloween with Him

episodes.synopsis: Tomo, Mona's childhood friend from Osaka, is here in Tokyo and ready to cause some chaos!
episodes.title: Best Friend with Him

episodes.synopsis: The gang hits up a theme park for Tomo's welcome party, and she and Asahi both have plans afoot!
episodes.title: Theme Park with Him

episodes.synopsis: Mona is stranded with Medaka at the theme park, leading to an important realization
episodes.title: Alone with Him

episodes.synopsis: Mona is in love! How will this change the dynamic between her and the gang, and Medaka most of all?
episodes.title: First Love with Him
